description: Returns the public profile of one listed operator: display name, business name, city, profession, years of experience, bio, Instagram handle and booking page URL. Provide exactly one of slug or operator_id.

operator_id.description: Numeric operator_id, as returned by search_operators.

slug.description: Operator slug, as returned by search_operators (for example "christiangflair").

name: get_operator
title: Get operator profile
